<!-- pr-reviewer: 8d5a2420a2e9280fb80e07dcf9b97ecda25e2cde -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety review. The change affects stock simulation and the gouge check.

- The turn keeps extra stock at the two ends. The rest calculation and the program simulation use the same turn.
- The program keeps gouges found before the turn.
- The field engine refuses this turn by name.
- No golden changed. No UI file changed. No new dependency or build script was added.

The checks ran locally on Linux. The PR was merged for this test with `upstream/main` at `db091cb38163f3713ce44918ea973855cd0960ad`. The trial merge had no conflict. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim` | 628 passed, 4 ignored |
| App unit tests | 313 passed, 1 ignored |
| `between_setups` | 8 passed |
| `carried_corner_rest` | 2 passed |
| `carried_engine_agreement` | 3 passed, 1 ignored |
| `carried_fixtures_cache` | 7 passed |
| `carried_verify` | 8 passed |
| `fixtures` | 14 passed |
| `post_not_judged` | 4 passed |
| `probe_only_sim` | 2 passed |
| `rest_across_setups` | 7 passed |
| `setup_carry` | 9 passed |
| `setup_carry_side` | 4 passed |
| `setup_stock_source` | 8 passed |
| `stock_engine_agreement` | 3 ignored |
| `stock_sim_document` | 9 passed |
| `stock_view` | 4 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

I repeated these mutation checks in the local worktree:

1. Changed the high end from `b + 1.5` to `b + 0.5`. `a_step_turned_side_on_is_never_read_short` failed: the floor was -9.5 instead of -10.5.
2. Changed the low end from `a - 0.5` to `a + 0.5`. `a_step_on_the_low_side_is_never_read_short_either` failed: the top was 9.5 instead of 10.5.

I restored the file. All 14 tests in `stock_carry_side` then passed. The local source matches the trial merge.

Requested before merge: none.

Limits: This review did not run the full quick gate, ignored tests, UI tests, Windows tests, or macOS tests. The separate job-thread path for a side-on prior plan was read but was not tested directly. The decision record states that the turn fills cavities and can add up to one cell at a turned face. These limits can cause extra rest cuts or a fixture refusal. Issues #1805 and #1806 track the stated follow-up work.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
